agent.description: Agent that receives the packet (010-002 D3): the generic `cdad-<role>` when the stack is absent, null or empty, or `cdad-<role>-<stack>` for any non-empty stack. Optional: historical requests published before this field stay admitted. It is excluded from the render. The schema only describes its FORM; role/stack coherence and dispatch timing are checks of the CLI.

execution_context.description: Project-relative canonical location of the v2 execution context the packet was prepared from: `.cdad/executions/<execution_id>/execution.json` (010-004 §4.1). Optional for historical requests; a new publication declares it, and then `agent` is mandatory.

current_decisions.description: Decision rows that govern the role of the packet (006-004 U1). Optional: absent or empty means the packet declares no row.

instruction_sources.description: Frozen instruction backup (015-001 D1): the ordered canonical sources (common, role, subphase), each entry carrying exactly path, sha256 and base64 snapshot. Optional: historical requests published before this field stay admitted. The schema only describes its FORM; path/order/digest/snapshot coherence is a CLI check.
